definitions.explanation: To become proficient at riding, driving, or operating something; to use something skillfully as if it were an extension of oneself.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{車|くるま}を{乗|の}りこなす。
examples.english: To master driving a new car.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{馬|うま}を{上手|じょうず}に{乗|の}りこなす。
このバイクを{乗|の}りこなすには{練習|れんしゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: It takes practice to master this motorcycle.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{乗|の}る (to ride) + こなす (to manage, handle skillfully)

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車|くるま}を{乗|の}りこなす: to master driving a car
- {馬|うま}を{乗|の}りこなす: to handle horses well
- バイクを{乗|の}りこなす: to master a motorcycle
- スキーを{乗|の}りこなす: to ski skillfully

EXTENDED MEANING:
Can also mean to master using technology or tools:
- 新しいソフトを{乗|の}りこなす: to master new software
